description: Screenshots, each requiring explicit per-request consent.
integrationApproach: consume the existing xdg-desktop-portal backend rather than implement a Bunny backend
notice: DO NOT USE AS THE DEFAULT SESSION
reason: A portal backend is a security-critical component that grants applications access to the screen and the filesystem. Writing a Bunny one would mean re-implementing consent handling that xdg-desktop-portal-gtk already does correctly, and V3 found no Bunny-specific requirement that the existing backend cannot meet.
